notes.title: 🔧 Update 0.7.1
notes.content:
Hello, Doctors! Team Supremun here.


🔧 Update 0.7.1 Contents

■ Additions
Added community links to title screen (Discord, X)
■ Fixes
Fixed issue where sound changes slightly based on character position

Reduced projectile size for firearms

Fixed issue where projectiles speed up when bouncing

Fixed ESC key malfunction during Event Waves

Fixed keyboard control issue after resuming from pause on item discovery screen

Please report bugs or feedback through Discord channel or Steam forums.

Thank you always for your valuable feedback.

notes.title: Demo Version Update - Seoul Comic World Edition
notes.content:
Hello, doctors! This is the Supre-Immune development team.

We've updated our demo to the latest version that was showcased at Seoul Comic World.
🆕 Major Update Contents
New Character Addition

Added 6 new immune cell characters

Each offers unique traits and playstyles

Evolution System Improvements

Enhanced evolution system usability

Optimized idea selection interface

Game Balance Adjustments

Rebalanced weapon synergy effects

Item effect balancing

Overall game difficulty curve improvements

Welcome to the world of immunity.
